description: This Java abstract class defines a base model for MongoDB write operations related to 'Thing' changes within the Eclipse Ditto project. It manages metadata, provides a method to generate a MongoDB write model, and implements common methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: AbstractWriteModel
classes.description: Abstract base class for MongoDB write models representing changes to 'Thing' entities, encapsulating metadata and providing foundational methods for subclasses.

methods.name: AbstractWriteModel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the write model with provided metadata.

methods.name: toMongo
methods.description: Abstract method to convert this model into a MongoDB write operation.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with this write model.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB filter based on the metadata's Thing ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on metadata object.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates hash code based on metadata.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the instance.
